algorithm: Try the two alternating parity layouts and sum distances between ordered odd positions and their target positions.
correctness_argument: Order within one parity never needs to change. Each adjacent swap crossing parities moves exactly one odd item one step, so the sum of ordered distances is both a lower bound and attainable. Only layouts with the correct parity counts are feasible.
edge_cases: Two feasible layouts for even length
problem_understanding: An alternating array has one of two possible starting parities.
